headline: A long lesson with an AI side path
overview: The public lesson combines structured teaching, diagrams, a quiz, and an optional AI panel. The walk reads into the lesson and opens that panel without claiming a model answer it did not request.

steps.title: The lesson begins with the decision problem
steps.description: The page starts with the forces a design must balance and exposes the wider curriculum in its navigation.

steps.title: The architecture is traced as a request
steps.action: Scrolled to "A simple read path with deliberate boundaries".
steps.description: The lesson moves from definitions to a concrete client, load balancer, service, cache, primary store, and replica path.
steps.screenshotAlt: The system-design lesson's simple read path diagram

steps.title: The AI path is present but unclaimed
steps.description: The question composer is visible, but this bounded walk does not submit a prompt or claim an answer it did not observe.
